upstream: Shared native read buffer portion of Sloppy b0796e307ad920e54ecb0aef328675d4f302d73b
change: One lazily allocated 64 KiB native socket scratch buffer replaces a new zero-filled buffer for every peer on every poll. Peer buffers and returned messages still own their bytes.
coverage: Default/release large messages from two peers in one poll, native/Node WebSocket echo, Netpong final state, software rendering and web module builds.
benchmark: Same compiler, old/new net.jo sources, seven alternating measured pairs plus warmup, 10000 polls at 1/8/32 peers, Linux local socket pairs; thread CPU measured inside the loop.
limits: Idle native transport microbenchmark only. No browser/WebRTC, game-frame-rate or bandwidth claim. Full C suite covered by hosted CI; library change validated locally with focused networking checks.
